points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable-source CMake build passed in a network-disabled scratch container with configured externals, 2 CPUs/4 GiB/128 processes and 240-second timeout; runtime-library search and compiler warnings remain.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:35–44 accepts --restart but never uses it; required case/output checks exist. Unknown flags are printed but do not necessarily abort.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates main, CGNS mesh, partition, numerics, solver and output; fixed 2-D states and monolithic driver limit extensibility.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Submitted C++ builds with MPI/CGNS/METIS; no direct existing complete CFD executable call found. No exhaustive external similarity/license audit.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON selects mesh/controls; no two-filename-only branch found. General unseen mesh layouts not independently exercised.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: solver.cpp:97–217 broadcasts full global mesh to all ranks and solver.hpp:38 retains it during solve, prohibited by TASK.md:227. METIS and local U exchange exist.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Steady code disables reconstruction at CFL>2 and metadata claims order 2. Re200 last_inner_residual_ratio is initialized 0 and never assigned; several steady force coefficients are negative or grossly high.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Original workspace cases and report pass structural validation; immutable source builds. No independent numerical order or case rerun was performed.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source builds with warnings; restart is ignored and metadata contains incorrect full-mesh and last-ratio values. PDF and raw results excluded from curated tip.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
